issue.title: Dogfood Plan Decisions in memory: plan-decision glossary strand, decisions record, generated_skills Plan Mode line

task_type_fields.proposed_change:
Record the shipped Plan Decisions feature in memory as one plan-first change, so its tale carries live memory decisions that Bryan answers in the new ACE Decisions panel (the feature's first real memory decision). Three changes:
1. Add a `glossary:plan-decision` strand ("Plan Decision", alias "memory decision"): a typed, defaulted reviewer choice declared in a plan's `decisions:` frontmatter and answered in plan review.
2. Add a `decisions` web record, "decisions, not gate options": typed choices live in plan frontmatter and resolve through one host resolver, not as gate options.
3. Add a "Plan Mode and Questions" line to `generated_skills.md` saying planners prefer Plan Decisions over /sase_questions when one complete plan can cover every answer.
Work it plan-first (/sase_plan) with one memory decision per note. Creating the new strand needs memory selectors that name a not-yet-existing note or strand to resolve with `exists: false` (the `new` chip). The sase-1hi landing child epic repairs that; until then the new strand's selector fails `decision-memory-unresolvable`.

issue.creation_reason: The Plan Decisions epic deliberately edited no memory (plan section 5.8); its memory notes are meant to land as the feature's first reviewed memory-decision plan.
